Hi Natalie,

Thanks for sending over invoice P-20261010 (attached). Our accounting team flagged two issues that prevent us from paying this as-is:

1) The invoice includes 20% VAT. This is a cross-border B2B service delivered to Redwood Inference (Ireland entity), so the correct treatment should be reverse charge — no supplier VAT should be applied. Please reissue without VAT and include the reverse-charge statement (e.g., "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive" or equivalent).

2) The VAT number on the invoice appears to be malformed: it lists GB123456789 but the VAT certificate we have (and your company profile) show VAT ID as PAY-GB-987654321 for UK. Our AP system rejects invoices when the VAT country code and number format don't match. Can you double-check the VAT identifier you want on the reissued invoice and send a scanned VAT certificate as evidence?

Can you confirm you can reissue a corrected invoice and provide the VAT cert? We need the corrected document to clear the payment hold — target is to process payment in the Oct month-end run.

Appreciate a quick turnaround.
